raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "A partial gist exclusion constraint on (staff_id, tstzrange(start_at, end_at)) WHERE status='confirmed' makes overlapping confirmed bookings for one master impossible at the database level, on any app server. Cancelled, completed and no-show bookings, other masters, and back-to-back slots (half-open range) are unaffected. The insert transaction rolls back on violation, and the 23P01 error (including when wrapped in a cause) is mapped to `slot_taken`."}
